name: Hokusai Manga vol.13 (attribution unconfirmed) - 2 leaves
description: Twinfold Reference Asset for two half-sheet (半丁) leaves from a bound book, mounted side by side in one mat. The series title "北斎漫画十三編" (Hokusai Manga, vol. 13) appears in the block margin (柱) of both leaves; the artist attribution to Katsushika Hokusai is unconfirmed (推定, confidence: medium). Neither leaf carries a signature (落款) -- Hokusai Manga does not sign individual plates. Publisher, censorship seal (改印), and this individual copy's printing period (Edo-period pull vs. later Meiji reprint vs. the 1969 Unsōdō reprint) are unconfirmed from the photographs alone. Museum catalogue records (Tokyo National Museum, Edo-Tokyo Museum archives) confirm the series' existence, half-sheet format, and a range of plausible publication dates (1830s-1849 depending on the source), but do not confirm a match to this specific copy's images. This description is a cataloguing note, not an authentication or grading certificate.

attributes.condition_notes: 画像からの所見、第三者評価ではない。淡彩摺（墨・灰・薄紅）、2枚とも黄変・くすみあり、左右とも虫損らしき小穴や汚れが散見。裏打ち・補修・補彩の有無、余白・トリミングの有無は写真からは判断不可
attributes.image_rights: 図柄は著作権消滅（北斎は1849年没）。掲載画像はTwinfoldが実物を撮影した写真2枚を傾き補正し、白いマット上に合成したもの。店の販売用ラベルは写っていない
